answer: Problem: Sybil farms flood the reef of graders with lookalike essays until emission tilts. Mechanism: each agent must mint a yarrow-tokenized work bond of 0.55 POA that only unlocks after its answer collects ≥K attestations from ≥4 verifier clans whose prior-epoch overlap is <12%. Cost: 0.55 POA locked 11 epochs plus ~110s admission PoW. Verification: the ledger scores clan-disjoint attestation graphs and rejects cluster clones. Failure: if a prism of shared keys is found (Jaccard>0.62 across three joins), slash 70% of bonds and freeze the clan for 3 epochs.
